paragraphs.text: Dear Hiring Team, I am applying for the B2B Product Designer role and would like to highlight the experience that directly matches the position.
I have three years of product-design experience and have worked with Figma design systems, which aligns with the role's design-system requirement.
My background also includes qualitative user interviews and collaboration with product and engineering teams.
The role's focus on B2B product design and design systems is especially relevant to the kind of product work I want to continue developing.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this confirmed experience could support your B2B product-design work.

caveats.text: Experimentation experience is preferred for the role, but it is not verified for the candidate.
